# Draft:Renaissance Africa Energy Company

Renaissance Africa Energy Company Limited. also commonly called, RAEC or simply just Renaissance is as a consortium, uniting five energy companies, including four independent Nigerian companies and an international company. (namely: ND Western Limited, Aradel Holdings Plc, FIRST Exploration and Petroleum Development Company Limited, and the Waltersmith Group).
It was incorporated in 2011 and is a fully integrated oil and gas company operating in Nigeria. The company is currently chaired by its Managing Director (MD), Tony Attah, who has also served as the Director of other major oil and gas exploration companies in Nigeria such as SNEPCo and Nigeria LNG
Purchase of the Shell Petroleum Development Company
On 13 March, 2025, Shell sold its Nigerian subsidiary, namely: The Shell Petroleum Development Company of Nigeria Limited (SPDC), to Renaissance following approvals from the Federal Government of Nigeria.
